decisions.reason: Bun fragment arrays outperformed repeated string concatenation across tested concurrency levels.
No consistent matched HTTP ratio benefit; render-only diagnostics did not reproduce a renderer slowdown.
Node streaming regressions and inconsistent Bun string latency.
Node streaming regressions; Bun string p99 worsened with negligible streaming gain.
Bun string p99 improved twice, but streaming c128 ratio fell 3.2% and large-page string ratios fell 1.7–2.7% at c32–64. All 24 controller tests passed. Performance guards failed.

Bun closed-loop gains did not survive scheduled demand. Streaming at 10000 offered RPS fell to 6552 versus matched unchanged control 6957. Fixture optimization would also need equivalent React preparation for a fair published comparison.
Per-request CPU collection perturbs capacity. Diagnostic collection and periodic process CPU must remain. Any protocol change must not be presented as a framework speedup.

caveats: node-threshold-large-string-95 and node-threshold-large-string-actual used ordinary Node pages; they are not valid large-page guards.
An unchanged Bun per-request-CPU control had two warmup ECONNRESET errors. Preserve raw evidence.
Historical references: Bun streaming 6681 valid RPS; Bun string 9998 valid RPS. The 9866 valid RPS reference belongs to Node streaming, not Bun string.
